newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound o/n rates down - bankers.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound o/n rates down - bankers.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell in the private-sector market on Wednesday to between 8-3/4 and 9-1/2 percent from between 8-7/8 and 9-3/4 percent on Tuesday, bankers said.
One bank said it borrowed at eight percent but this appeared to be a rogue deal out of line with the mainstream market.
Few bankers dealt one-week but they quoted rates between 8-7/8 and 9-1/2 percent, against nine percent on Tuesday.
The bankers said they expected rates to fall early in July, after public sector banks have balanced their books for the end of the financial year. The year ends on June 30.
